title: Turn ends with a question in plain text, no explicit signal -> failed missing-output, hinted
rule: specs/aip-58.mdx section 3 Outcome rule -- a heuristic MAY only annotate a hint, never produce suspended

steps.prompt: Write a one-page pricing brief for these tiers: $steps.parse.tiers

agentTurn.finalMessage: What tone should the brief use -- formal or casual?

notes: The final message is textually identical to V2's -- a question about tone. The outcome differs because V2's step made an explicit run.requestInput call and this one didn't; a host is NOT permitted to read the two turns identically just because their prose matches.

A host MAY set StepRecord.hint = 'possible-input-request' after pattern-matching the trailing question mark, purely as a triage aid for a human reading the failed run. The hint MUST NOT change stepStatus/terminalState -- a conformance check that flips this vector's expected terminalState to 'suspended' on the basis of the hint is testing a non-conforming host.
No step.suspended or run.suspended event may appear anywhere in this run's event log.

manifestExcerpt.steps[0] declares an outputSchema (added 2026-09-25, alongside section 3's vacuous-contract amendment) so this vector actually exercises missing-output -- a step declaring no contract at all has a vacuous contract (section 3) and always succeeds on turn end, which would make this vector inapplicable as written.
